node.label: Fed balance sheet
node.up: The Fed is holding more assets — QE, or emergency lending
node.what: Everything the Federal Reserve owns. It grows when the Fed buys bonds with money it creates (QE) and shrinks when it lets them mature (QT). This is the number people mean when they say 'money printing'.
